title: V01-C17 Collections and Iteration Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: A traversal plan with start, bound, step, current element, invariant, and exact visited-index trace for empty, single, multiple, and out-of-bounds cases; plus explicit behavior for mutation during traversal.

Language-independent explanations and equivalent loop/JavaScript implementations of mapping, filtering, and reduction, including cardinality, callback contract, initial accumulator, empty-case behavior, and one-pass versus multiple-pass trade-off.

accessibility_requirements: Array diagrams label index and value independently.
Traversal visuals include numbered visited positions.
Accumulator tables expose state before and after each element.
Turkish terms include English only at first meaningful use.
Code comments and explanations are Turkish.
known_risks: Length may be confused with last index.
Traversal may visit one extra or one fewer element.
Array mutation during iteration may skip or duplicate behavior.
Map may be used only for side effects.
Reduce without initial value may fail or change accumulator shape.
One pass may be chosen prematurely for perceived performance.
exclusions: sets and maps as primary structures
